newsitem.title: USA: Besicorp target of Federal investigation.
newsitem.headline: Besicorp target of Federal investigation.

text.p: Besicorp Group Inc said Thursday that it and its chief executive and president Michael Zinn have been notified by a U.S. attorney's office that they are targets of a grand jury probe over alleged campaign contributions.

The power and energy developer said the letter from the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Southern District of New York said it was investigating whether Zinn and/or Besicorp solicited Besicorp employees to contribute to the 1992 congressional campaign of Maurice Hinchey and then reimbursed those employees with bonuses, raises or cash.

The government is also probing whether they solicited Ansaldo North America Inc or Ansaldo Industria of America Inc, which according to the Italian Trade Commission are units of a state-owned Italian corporation, to make illicit corporate contributions to the Hinchey campaign.

The company said that the government states in the letter that Ansaldo has pleaded guilty in this matter pursuant to a plea agreement, and that Ansaldo and some of its current and former employees agreed to cooperate with the government in this investigation, implicating Zinn and Besicorp.
The company said it will not comment on ongoing legal matters, but believes the investigation and its outcome will not have a material adverse effect on its business.
